key_findings: ESP block reduced early postoperative pain and opioid consumption and lowered 24 h VEGF and cortisol versus control in breast cancer surgery.
Metabolomics showed altered bile acid, steroid hormone, porphyrin, amino acid and glutathione pathways in the ESP group.
